limitations: Official vector coverage is limited to the declared extraction boxes near Aubagne; 1,404 buildings and 472 road sections are not an exhaustive reconstruction of Marseille or the game territory.
The LiDAR source date is 2021-06-26 and its attribution mentions edition 2025-03-14. October 2026 extraction/inspection dates are not new survey dates.
Native 0.5 m pixels and reprojected WGS84 sample spacing are documented separately; spacing is not an altimetric or building-position accuracy guarantee.
Nearest-neighbor conversion and runtime terrain interpolation remain declared. The high-resolution mesh is bounded; it does not certify fine rendering across the entire territory.

Building envelopes, unknown roof shapes, absent declared heights, and geometry Z flagged as missing do not become measured architectural reconstructions. Source-panel counters use their explicit declared meanings.
The authored campaign scenes, actors and Fallout-like systems remain game content, not geographic survey data. Assisted/funded-character tests are not a complete human campaign playthrough.

Rendering and controller component fixtures do not independently certify the final complete HTML or physical hardware. No full PWA, cross-browser, console, mobile-performance or publication certification is inferred.
